game.name: Pocket Tracker Extreme
game.desc: Pocket Tracker Extreme 0.2.0-beta.2 by Kid Bunka — independent GPL music studio for TrimUI Brick / KNULLI. Expanded synthesis, presets, sample editing, online digging, Drumlab, performance effects and mastering. Earlier musical workflows user-tested; current-beta hardware acceptance remains open. Direct iPhone recording failed in the current user setup; interfaces are separately untested.
